text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for cross-service sync (API v2.4.3, runtime 1.9.0-rc, console UI 3.1.0, router 5.7.2). Change window: 2026-03-21 02:00-03:00 UTC. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 20m intervals. Owners: api, runtime, console, router. Please ack and post any blockers.

rachel: Acked. I’ll run the preflight checklist at -30m and coordinate rollouts. Release notes live at /docs/releases/2026-03-21-sync.md. Putting runbook link in thread.

tyler: API team green. Schema migration toggle off for the window. Pinned client-compat on older SDKs. Rollback criteria: p99 > 200ms or error-rate > 0.5%.

frank: runtime: image pushed to registry, quant profile applied. Important: KV-cache warmup required after canary to prevent cold-latency spikes. I’ll post the warmup command.

sasha: console: feature flag staged to canary users. I’ll run smoke tests against the canary once traffic routing is in place — need the test job id.

frank: KV warmup command: ```kubectl exec -it warmup -- ./warmup --model gpt-redwood-v1 --prefixes /tmp/prefetch.txt```

roberto: router: we’ll scope canary to us-east-1 initially and route by region. Fallback policy -> runtime-v1.8 if latency breach. Can we limit canary to us-east-1 only at first? I want to avoid cross-region blast.

rachel: Good call. Updated plan: canary in us-east-1 only. 5% -> 25% -> expand global pending metrics. Tyler, can you disable auto-global-route for stage?

tyler: Disabled auto-global-route. Added emergency pin command for API: `redwood pin api v2.4.2 --scope org` in case we need instant rollback.

oncall-bot: Reminder: PagerDuty rotation indicates @alice is on-call for 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC.

alice: I’m oncall and standing by. If rollback is needed, tag me and I’ll coordinate incident and communication.

rachel: Confirming rollback triggers: p99 latency > 200ms sustained for 5m OR error rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR user-facing throttling > 0.2% — any objections?

tyler: Also add a model-quality regression: increase in eval false positives > 2% triggers manual rollback review (soft rollback).

sasha: Note: console integration test #428 is flaky; I’ll rerun before the window and report status.

frank: After full rollout, I’ll run KV-cache warmup across all nodes (estimated 6m). Will post progress.

rachel: Ops checklist items preflight: 1) run smoke tests, 2) confirm dashboard alerts wired, 3) update release notes, 4) confirm pins for rollback.

rachel: OK — everyone reply with :thumbsup: when ready.

tyler: :thumbsup:

frank: :thumbsup:

sasha: :thumbsup: (re-running test #428 now)

roberto: :thumbsup: will keep router splicing tight for canary scope.

alice: :thumbsup: oncall ready.

deploy-bot: Deploy will move to preflight at -30m and start canary at 02:00 UTC as scheduled. Logs and progress will post here.

rachel: Thanks all — closing coordination loop. If anything changes, update thread and ping @alice for incident escalation.
